# weft_network (Resource)

Virtual network within a project. Mirrors CreateNetwork / RenameNetwork / SetNetworkDNS / SetNetworkDefaultSecurityGroups / DeleteNetwork.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4/IPv6 CIDR (e.g. "10.42.0.0/24"). Immutable.
- `name` (String) Network name (display label). Mutable via RenameNetwork.
- `project` (String) Owning project (display name or UUID). Immutable.

### Optional

- `default_security_group_uuids` (List of String) SG UUIDs auto-applied to every NIC joining this network. Mutable via SetNetworkDefaultSecurityGroups.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) Resolvers handed to VMs joining this network. Mutable via SetNetworkDNS.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway address inside the CIDR. Immutable.
- `type` (String) Network backend: "nat" | "bridged" | "isolated". Defaults to "nat". Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Unix nanosecond timestamp of creation.
- `id` (String) Mirrors `uuid`; satisfies the Terraform ID convention.
- `project_uuid` (String) Resolved project UUID (computed from `project`).
- `uuid` (String) Server-minted network UUID.
